title: 第一卷 第24章 工欲善其事，必先利其器
novel_title: 重回九八：我在小渔村兴风作浪
content_zh:
李华翻身坐起来，看到阿青拿来的两个菜，一盆米饭，问道：“这是特地给我准备的？”

    阿青点点头：“我让我妈特地留的。”

    李华惊奇：“你就不怕我在家里吃过饭回来？”

    阿青摇摇头：“你自从到这住，就算是回去，也都是饿着肚子回来。”

    “有几次，你不还让我偷摸从家里拿东西来吃嘛。”

    李华：“……”

    啊这……

    怪不得千琴婶子那么不待见他。

    阿青把碗碟盘子放在床上，摆好，递过来筷子。

    李华没客气。

    大快朵颐起来。

    一口米饭，一口菜。

    本来还没觉得有多饿，这一吃，就饿的感觉能吃下去一头牛，筷子夹了菜，疯狂的往嘴里塞。

    觉得噎得慌。

    一杯水递到跟前。

    接过来。

    吨吨吨的喝完，这才看到，递水的不是阿青，而是滕千琴。

    他赶紧招呼道：“婶子。”

    滕千琴笑眯眯的招呼道：“哎，慢点吃。”

    李华一愣。

    不对劲。

    十分有一百分的不对劲。

    上一世，到滕千琴死，对他可都没有过笑脸。

    这怎么还主动给他倒水喝了？

    他擦擦嘴，问道：“婶子，有事不？”

    滕千琴说道：“阿青拿回家一千块钱，说是你带他赶海挣的，这事怎么回事？”

    李华“哦”了一声。

    把来龙去脉说了说，这也没什么好藏着掖着的，在卖货的时候，可有不少人都看到了。

    一传十，十传百的。

    用不了多久，十里八村都知道他在滩涂地赶海抓了一麻袋海参。

    没准会越传越离谱。

    滕千琴听完，笑道：“那你们运气真不错。”

    阿青嘚瑟道：“哥说明天退大潮还要带我去滩涂地赶海呢。”

    滕千琴说道：“去什么滩涂地，那地方走进去都费劲，还是去礁石滩，明天退大潮，货肯定更多。”

    李华说道：“婶子，话是这么说没错。”

    “不过，我抓那么多海参的事情传开，明天去滩涂地的人肯定不少。”

    “我不想和人去挤。”

    滕千琴点点头：“也是。”
content_en:
Li Hua turned over and sat up. He saw the two dishes and a bowl of rice brought by A Qing and asked, "Is this specially prepared for me?"

    Ah Qing nodded: "I asked my mother to keep it specially."

    Li Hua was surprised: "Aren't you afraid that I will come back after having dinner at home?"

    Ah Qing shook his head: "Since you came to live here, even if you go back, you always come back hungry."

    "A few times, you let me sneak food from home to eat."

    Li Hua: "..."

    Ah this...

    No wonder Aunt Qianqin doesn't like to see him so much.

    Ah Qing put the dishes on the bed, arranged them, and handed over the chopsticks.

    Li Hua is not polite.

    Enjoy your meal.

    A bite of rice, a bite of vegetables.

    I didn't feel very hungry at first, but after eating, I felt so hungry that I could eat a cow. I picked up the vegetables with my chopsticks and crazily stuffed them into my mouth.

    Feeling choked.

    A glass of water was handed to me.

    Take it.

    After drinking tons and tons of water, I saw that the person passing the water was not A Qing, but Teng Qianqin.

    He quickly greeted: "Auntie."

    Teng Qianqin greeted with a smile: "Hey, eat slowly."

    Li Hua was stunned.

    Something is wrong.

    Something is 100% wrong.

    In the last life, until Teng Qianqin died, she never smiled at him.

    Why did you take the initiative to pour him water?

    He wiped his mouth and asked, "Auntie, are you okay?"

    Teng Qianqin said: "Ah Qing took home a thousand yuan and said you earned it by taking him to the sea. What's going on?"

    Li Hua said "Oh".

    After telling the whole story, there is nothing to hide. Many people saw it when the goods were being sold.

    One spreads to ten, and ten spreads to hundreds.

    It wouldn't be long before everyone in the village knew that he had caught a sack of sea cucumbers on the tidal flats.

    Maybe it will become more and more outrageous as it spreads.

    After hearing this, Teng Qianqin smiled and said, "Then you are really lucky."

    Ah Qing said with a smile: "Brother said that tomorrow when the tide goes out, he will take me to the tidal flat to catch the sea."

    Teng Qianqin said: "If we go to any tidal flat, it's difficult to walk into that place. It's better to go to the reef beach. The tide will recede tomorrow and there will definitely be more goods."

    Li Hua said: "Auntie, you are right."

    "However, if word spreads about me catching so many sea cucumbers, there will definitely be a lot of people going to the tidal flat tomorrow."

    "I don't want to crowd with people."

    Teng Qianqin nodded: "Yes."
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 24 If a worker wants to do his job well, he must first sharpen his tools
